newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine bank to get $15 mln export finance credit.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine bank to get $15 mln export finance credit.

text.p: Ukraine's largest commercial bank expects to get a $15 million export financing credit from a group of foreign banks headed by Austria's Raiffeisen Zentralbank, a Bank Ukraina spokesman said on Friday.
"An agreement to give our bank this interbank credit will be signed in April," Oleh Hontarev, chief of the bank's foreign relations department, told Reuters.
The one-year loan would go to finance export and import contracts, mainly in the agricultural sector, Hontarev said.
Six commercial banks from Germany, the Netherlands, Poland and the Czech Republic had expressed interest in participating in the loan, he said.
